concepts.explanation: This is the project's name for the strip between the manager chat and the message field. Closed, it is one line. Open, it is the decision list and then the running tasks.
A section that shows only its heading until you tap it (HTML `<details>`). It keeps rarely needed text one tap away without taking space.

In Markdown, a line that starts with four spaces counts as code, even in normal text. Accidental indents then show prose in a monospace box. Fenced blocks (```) mark code clearly, so the indented form is turned off on task surfaces.
The stored task stays as written, and each reader gets a cleaned title computed when it asks. One rule change fixes old and new tasks on every screen without a migration.
